nfl.oneThing: Seattle beat Kansas City 20–3 on Sunday night, with Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 150 receiving yards the big offensive story. It was the Seahawks' first win after two straight losses.

headlines.title: Seahawks' defence slows Kansas City in 20–3 win
headlines.summary: Seattle beat the Chiefs 20–3 on Sunday night. Sam Darnold threw for 257 yards and a touchdown, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine passes for 150 yards and a score. Emanuel Wilson ran for 100 yards on 24 carries. Patrick Mahomes finished 19 of 33 for 165 yards, with no touchdowns and one interception, and Kenneth Walker III was held to 36 yards. Seattle played almost entirely in nickel, which the Seahawks' defence used to take away Kansas City's run game.
headlines.whyItMatters: Kansas City is still 5–1 and the AFC's top seed. Seattle, at 4–3, has its season back on track after losing to the 49ers and Broncos.

headlines.title: Lions edge Packers 20–17 in NFC North game
headlines.summary: Detroit beat Green Bay 20–17 in a game decided by three points. Jared Goff threw for 303 yards and two touchdowns on 22 of 32 passing, and Amon-Ra St. Brown caught nine passes for 153 yards. Jordan Love threw for 274 yards and two touchdowns, but also threw an interception. Green Bay has further injury problems: Zaire Franklin has a hairline fracture in his leg and Sean Rhyan is believed to have a high ankle sprain. Detroit also has ankle concerns for St. Brown and Ennis Rakestraw, and the team does not expect either to practise on Wednesday.
headlines.whyItMatters: Detroit is 4–2 and sixth in the NFC, and Green Bay is 4–3 and seventh. Both are in the playoff picture, and the margin in this race is small.

headlines.title: Broncos win 30–16 over Cardinals
headlines.summary: Denver beat Arizona 30–16. Bo Nix threw for 222 yards and a touchdown on 15 of 29 passing and ran for another score on seven carries. RJ Harvey added two catches for 54 yards and a touchdown. For Arizona, Jacoby Brissett threw for 272 yards and a touchdown, and Trey McBride caught 10 passes for 111 yards and a score. Arizona will also be without receiver Jalen Brooks, who will have season-ending wrist surgery.
headlines.whyItMatters: Denver has won three straight and sits fifth in the AFC at 5–2. Arizona is 2–5 and now has one fewer receiver for the rest of the season.

headlines.title: Harbaugh fires back at flag on Skattebo's helmet hit
headlines.summary: The Giants beat the Texans 27–21 on Sunday, but the talking point was a penalty. Cam Skattebo lowered his helmet into Texans safety M.J. Stewart on a 7-yard run, and was flagged for unnecessary roughness. The flag moved New York from second-and-3 at the 30 to first-and-20 at its own 13. Harbaugh argued with an official on the sideline and on Monday said the way Skattebo ran was "the way you're supposed to run".
headlines.whyItMatters: New York is 4–2–1 and third in the NFC.

teamNews.title: Kirk Cousins stays Raiders' starter
teamNews.text: Klint Kubiak said "Kirk is our starting quarterback" and "there is no controversy" ahead of the trip to the Jets. Cousins threw for 295 yards and two touchdowns against the Rams after a shaky first half, and leads the NFL with 16 touchdown passes. Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 pick, will wait.

teamNews.text: Bech broke his forearm in Week 3 and has been on injured reserve since. He now has 21 days to practise before he must be added to the 53-man roster, and one report says he could play against the Jets.

contextCard.title: What "designated to return" means
contextCard.body: A player on injured reserve can't play straight away. When he's ready, the team designates him to return, which lets him practise. The team then has a 21-day window to add him back to the 53-man roster. Bech's designation starts that clock now.

nba.oneThing: Thunder star Jalen Williams was stretchered off on Sunday night with a serious injury. It changes Oklahoma City's title hopes and gives the Spurs an opening in the West.

headlines.title: Jalen Williams' injury reshapes the West
headlines.summary: Jalen Williams had to be stretchered off the court on Sunday night, and Oklahoma City now has to work out life without him. CBS Sports says trading for a replacement won't be simple. The Thunder are 3–0 and have already lost Cason Wallace (sore shoulder) and Chet Holmgren (knee), who are both out for Monday's game against the Suns. USA Today says the injury puts the Spurs back in the West's driver's seat.
headlines.whyItMatters: Oklahoma City is second in the West on the standings, but the depth problem is now real. San Antonio, at 1–2, is 9th in the West and has more room to move up.

headlines.title: Doncic's 52 points lift Lakers over Jazz
headlines.summary: Luka Doncic had 52 points, eight rebounds, 10 assists and eight threes as the Lakers beat the Jazz 132–123. Austin Reaves added 29 points. Utah had Lauri Markkanen with 28 points and Keyonte George with 24 points and 10 assists, but could not stop Doncic in the second half. Doncic is averaging 34.3 points a game, second in the league.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers are 3–0 and third in the West. They are one of five unbeaten teams in the conference, along with Minnesota, Oklahoma City, Memphis and Houston.

headlines.title: Knicks start 0–3 after loss to Magic
headlines.summary: The Knicks lost 111–102 to the Magic, and Yahoo notes they are only the third defending champion in NBA history to start a season with three straight losses. Jalen Brunson scored 28 points and Karl-Anthony Towns had 22 points and 14 rebounds, but New York could not get the win. Franz Wagner had 23 points, 13 rebounds and nine assists for Orlando, and Desmond Bane added 22. Yahoo argues the Knicks' expensive roster is not making enough shots.
headlines.whyItMatters: New York is 0–3 and 12th in the East. It's early, but the team's slow start is a real issue.

headlines.title: Wolves and Blazers lead early net rating
headlines.summary: Minnesota beat Toronto 117–94 to stay unbeaten. Anthony Edwards had 26 points and LaMelo Ball had 15 points and eight assists. RealGM's first-week net rating has Portland at the top, outscoring opponents by 24.5 points per 100 possessions, and Minnesota second at 23.0. Phoenix and Miami rank last. Edwards was added to the injury report on Monday for right knee injury management.
headlines.whyItMatters: Minnesota is 3–0 and first in the West. Net rating after one week is useful, but the sample is small.

teamNews.title: Spurs beat Mavericks, then lose to Rockets
teamNews.text: San Antonio beat Dallas 122–106 on the road on Saturday, with Wembanyama and Dylan Harper leading the way. The Spurs then lost to Houston, when Amen Thompson blocked Wembanyama's last-second shot. They are 1–2 and play Sacramento on Tuesday.

teamNews.title: Tyon Grant-Foster drafted in G League
teamNews.text: Wing Tyon Grant-Foster was taken No. 15 in the G League draft by the Sioux Falls Skyforce, the Heat's affiliate. He spent the summer in the Spurs organisation after going undrafted, and averaged 1.0 point in 3.8 minutes through four games with San Antonio.
